mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, member_id, reservation_date, status ) VALUES ( #{peopleCount}, #{representativeName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{courseName}, #{remarks}, #{memberId}, #{reservationDate}, 'RESERVED' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, created_at, member_id, status, reservation_date, member_deleted, admin_deleted FROM reservations WHERE status = 'RESERVED' AND admin_deleted = false ORDER BY reservation_date DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT id, people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, created_at, member_id, status, reservation_date, member_deleted, admin_deleted FROM reservations WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, created_at, member_id, status, reservation_date, member_deleted, admin_deleted FROM reservations WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'RESERVED' AND reservation_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND member_deleted = false ORDER BY reservation_date ASC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, created_at, member_id, status, reservation_date, member_deleted, admin_deleted FROM reservations WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND member_deleted = false AND ( status IN ('CANCELED', 'COMPLETED') OR reservation_date < CURRENT_DATE ) ORDER BY reservation_date DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, created_at, member_id, status, reservation_date, member_deleted, admin_deleted FROM reservations WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET representative_name = #{representativeName}, reservation_date = #{reservationDate}, people_count = #{peopleCount}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, course_name = #{courseName}, remarks = #{remarks} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT rr.id, rr.reservation_id, rr.member_id, rr.request_type, rr.request_reason, rr.status, rr.refund_status, rr.admin_comment, rr.created_at, rr.processed_at,
r.reservation_date, r.people_count, r.representative_name, r.phone_number, r.course_name, r.status AS reservation_status,
m.name AS member_name, m.email AS member_email
FROM reservation_requests rr INNER JOIN reservations r ON rr.reservation_id = r.id INNER JOIN members m ON rr.member_id = m.id WHERE rr.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC

SELECT id, people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, created_at, member_id, status, reservation_date, member_deleted, admin_deleted FROM reservations WHERE admin_deleted = false AND ( status IN ('CANCELED', 'COMPLETED') OR reservation_date < CURRENT_DATE ) ORDER BY reservation_date DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, people_count, representative_name, phone_number, course_name, remarks, created_at, member_id, status, reservation_date, member_deleted, admin_deleted FROM reservations WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'RESERVED' AND reservation_date >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND member_deleted = false ORDER BY reservation_date ASC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1
